verdict.rationale: kitty has a documented programmable surface: a remote-control CLI and a graphics protocol spec, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. The remote-control docs are a static reference, an adjacent feature rather than the interactive, runnable explorer the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
